thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD12345 — edge.tls.handshake.spike detected. Multiple TLS handshake failures observed across ALB -> edge POPs in us-west-2 and eu-central. Error rate spike started ~14:02 UTC. See logs: https://logs.internal/recent/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD12345 triggered by threshold: tls.handshake.errors > 5% over 1m. Paging on-call.

Jordan: Ack — oncall here, investigating. Any recent deploys, cert rotations, or DNS changes in the last 30m?

Maya: I pushed a weighted Route53 shift for blue-green on the edge routing around 13:45 UTC (60/40 us->eu) while finishing a small config tweak. No cert changes from my side.

Liam: Looking at ALB/edge logs — spike in TLS handshake failures and increased 525/526 style errors. Sample from edge logs:
```
2026-03-14T14:03:12Z ERROR tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-14T14:03:13Z WARN healthcheck failed for target i-0abc123: TLS handshake error
```

Jordan: Confirming target-group svc-api-prod shows unhealthy_count increased to ~30% in us-west-2 and ~18% in eu-central since 14:02 UTC. Healthcheck type: HTTPS with SNI. Trying a quick re-register of targets to see if it's transient.

Priya: I see an ACM rotation event at 14:01 UTC — a new certificate was issued and deployed to edge listeners. Some edge POPs are reporting "certificate signed by unknown authority" which smells like a missing intermediate/root in the chain being served by certain POP replicas. Health probes that validate chain fail, so health checks flip.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Jordan (ack at 2719924520). Escalation timer set: 20m.

Jordan: Mitigation plan (brief):
1) Roll back Route53 weight change to previous state (Maya) to reduce cross-region exposure and stabilize client distribution.
2) Fail traffic away from impacted POP region if needed (Liam) — move traffic to eu-west-1 as temporary fallback.
3) Re-issue/attach ACM cert with full chain or reattach previous cert (Priya).
4) Monitor ALB healthchecks and error rate; update status page and notify customers.

Maya: Rolling back weights now — applying previous Route53 change-batch (TTL 60):
```json
{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.prod.edge.redwood.com","Type":"A","Weight":100}}]}
```
Applying... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Liam: Initiating emergency traffic shift to eu-west-1 for API edge (routing policy override). Setting Route53 temporary policy, TTL 60. Will monitor latency and error rate.

Priya: Opening ACM support request and preparing to reissue cert with full CA chain. If ACM propagation lags, we can reattach the previous working cert to ALB listeners as a fallback. Also checking CDN edge config for cached cert fragments.

Jordan: After rollback and traffic shift — immediate signal: TLS handshake error rate decreased from ~12% -> ~2% within 3 minutes. Healthchecks for svc-api-prod improved to ~96% healthy in us-west-2 (was 70%). Still seeing a few stragglers for clients with cached endpoints.

incident-bot: PD12345 status update: Mitigated -> monitoring.

Jordan: Handing off monitoring to Maya for the next 2 hours. @Maya you're oncall; if error rate crosses 5% escalate to SRE lead @Priya. Leaving notes in incident channel.

Maya: Ack — I'll keep an eye. Drafting a short status page note and coordinating with Support to message impacted customers. Initial customer impact estimate: ~3-6% of global requests experienced TLS handshake errors between 14:02-14:12 UTC; >80% recovered automatically after rollback.

Elena-support: Support here — notifying top accounts in affected regions, opening high-priority tickets for any customers reporting errors. Will coordinate PS outreach if needed.

Jordan: Post-incident actions (short):
- Add preflight cert chain verification step to our cert rollout playbook.
- Avoid simultaneous Route53 weight changes during cert rotations.
- Add canary checks that validate full chain from multiple edge POPs.
Assigning postmortem owners: Priya (certing) & Maya (routing).

Priya: Creating follow-up ticket SRE-2556 to cover cert-chain verification, deploy gating, and healthcheck improvements. Also recommending healthcheck change: validate host SNI separately to avoid false-negative target churn during cert rotation.

Maya: Thanks — I'll also add a small automation to pause weighted Route53 operations during ACME/ACM rotations.

Jordan: If stable for 30m we'll close the PD and mark incident as resolved. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:

Elena-support: Will update customers and close tickets if no more reports come in.

pagerduty: PD12345 resolved at 2719927530 (after monitoring window).

Jordan: Final note: timeline and evidence attached in the postmortem doc. We'll schedule a blameless review tomorrow.
